exposure: Hybrid Circle of Security Intensive intervention (COS-I-RH) delivered individually or in groups
cohort: New Zealand parent-child dyads (n=36, child age M = 35 months) with relationship concerns, referred to a community-based program.
finding: Parents showed large improvements on all four indices of caregiving behavior and representations after the COS-I-RH intervention, which were maintained at one-year follow-up, regardless of individual or group delivery mode.
